narrative:
Jefferson County has 42,976 registered voters, with 59.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 18.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 22.1%, a modest Democratic lean of 4.1 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.0% of registrants.
